# Deploy notes

Run database migrations only after the nightly backup completes, and never on Fridays. Keep at least 3 replicas running during the rollout; fewer can fail customer requests.

To roll back, redeploy the previous image tag with the deploy command.

It is worth noting that, basically, in order to deploy the service safely, you should run the
database migrations only after the nightly backup completes, and you should never run them on
Fridays. As previously mentioned above, the cluster must always keep at least 3 replicas running.

- Migrations: after the nightly backup only; Fridays: never.
- Rollout: minimum of three replicas.
